narrative.headMessage: Profit guidance rose faster than sales
narrative.subMessage: 2026 midpoints raised: revenue 12.5%, operating income 25.9%, EPS 31.7%
narrative.headline: Profit guidance rose faster than sales
narrative.summary: All three 2026 guidance lines were raised, and the two profit lines were raised roughly twice as far as revenue.
narrative.story: Raising the revenue midpoint says more units are expected to ship. Raising the operating income midpoint further says the units are expected to be built better than the last plan assumed. That is a claim about the factory, and it is checkable in one quarter.
keyTakeaways: Non-GAAP operating income raised 25.9% and non-GAAP EPS 31.7%.
